boards.caption: Meet Petros Haffenrichter, one of the teachers of the Jivamukti Yoga Tribe Gathering 2027 in Luxembourg, 2–5 September 2027. "Growing up in different cultures, Petros Haffenrichter came to appreciate life as a union of polarities at a young age. Life is thrilling but demanding, beautiful but challenging, graceful but incomprehensible through mere logic." Registration is open at tribe.jivamuktiyoga.com.

boards.caption: Meet Emma Henry, one of the teachers of the Jivamukti Yoga Tribe Gathering 2027 in Luxembourg, 2–5 September 2027. "Emma Henry was introduced to yoga in the mid-1990s and has been teaching since 1998. Her background in dance and martial arts is evident in her dynamic, innovative and playful choreography and understanding of anatomy and the subtle body." Registration is open at tribe.jivamuktiyoga.com.

boards.caption: Meet Moritz Ulrich, one of the teachers of the Jivamukti Yoga Tribe Gathering 2027 in Luxembourg, 2–5 September 2027. "Moritz Ulrich is the co-director of Peace Yoga Berlin – Jivamukti Yoga School, an Advanced Certified Jivamukti Yoga teacher and a medical doctor. After having practised almost daily for several years, studying with different teachers from all yoga traditions, Moritz decided to start teaching yoga." Registration is open at tribe.jivamuktiyoga.com.

"Yoga arose in Anna Lunegova's life when she was a student in the modern dance branch of the State Academy of Arts and Culture.
